name: Gokurakuji Temple
text: Buddhist temple dedicated to Avalokiteśvara in Kameoka, Japan.

depictions.name: Gokurakuji Temple
depictions.text: Gokurakuji Temple was a Buddhist temple located in the Onyu Pass in Wakasa, Japan. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki members Fujibayashi Naoe and Yasuke arrived at the temple and recovered two pages scattered around its grounds.
